_comment: Casora-Panel-Übersetzung. Schlüssel = englischer Originaltext im Panel. Neue Sprache: Datei <code>.json anlegen, dann tools/build-panel-i18n.py.

exact.Separate entries with commas; an entry m: Separate entries with commas; an entry may have several words. The calendar popup still shows them.
exact.Press here to resolve a conflict between: Press here to resolve a conflict between different camera tiles
exact.Camera popup: Stream in the popup on the: Stream in the popup on the phone
exact.Camera popup: The stream the popup start: The stream the popup starts with. With more than one stream the popup shows a switch below the picture; the choice there holds until the browser is closed.
exact.Every tile of this camera opens this pop: Every tile of this camera opens this popup on this dashboard, also when it opens by itself.
The same for every tile of this camera. Set it under Home & devices → Cameras.
exact.Add a camera to change its popup setting: Add a camera to change its popup settings.
exact.Cards Casora does not manage. They sit b: Cards Casora does not manage. They sit below the tiles, exactly as
Adds a Blinds row to the climate popup.
exact.Sensors or events that count as a ring a: Sensors or events that count as a ring at this camera. Entities that belong to this camera come first.
exact.Sensors or events that count as a detect: Sensors or events that count as a detection at this camera. The name comes from Home Assistant.
exact.When two cameras want to open at the sam: When two cameras want to open at the same time, a ring goes first, otherwise the order of this list.
